objective: Compile reviewed project manifests into deterministic, content-hashed catalog artifacts: compact catalog, detail payloads, facet dictionaries and bitsets, search documents, audit report, and hashed manifest.
prohibitedChanges: No React, components, or visual tokens
No schema edits - packages/contracts is frozen; a change needs an ADR and a migration
No new runtime dependency without an ADR stating compressed cost, fallback, and removal path
No inferred project claims, metrics, or evidence (PRD 5.1.1, 12.2)
No relaxing of any rule in the registry to make a build pass
deliverables: Deterministic compiler with the PRD 5.1.2 stage pipeline
GitHub enrichment client with conditional requests, bounded queue, and rate-limit stop conditions
Media processor producing AVIF/WebP/fallback with intrinsic dimensions
Audit report: additions, removals, field changes, stale records, broken evidence, taxonomy changes, budget deltas
acceptance: Repeated builds from identical inputs are byte-identical (BLD-DETERMINISM-001)
Every invalid fixture is rejected with file path, JSON pointer, rule id, rejected value, and repair (PRD 5.1.6)
Full 1,300-project build with cached enrichment completes within BUILD-FULL-1300
Every generated artifact is within its budget in config/budgets.v1.json
No GitHub token appears in any bundle, log, or preview output
